 ERCOT Batch Zero Process for Large Load Interconnection:
        Section 9.2.2(3) Valid Stability Study Form
Instructions: This Section 9.2.2.(3) Form (“Form”) must be completed by the Interconnecting
Transmission Service Provider (TSP) for a Large Load that has a dynamic stability study on or
before July 10, 2026. The Interconnecting TSP provides this Form in accordance with Electric
Reliability Council of Texas, Inc.’s Planning Guide Section 9.2.2(3) as stated in Planning Guide
Revision Request 145, which is subject to approval by the Public Utility Commission of Texas.
All fields must be completed unless otherwise noted. This Form must be returned to ERCOT on
or before July 24, 2026. Questions regarding this Form may be sent to:
llwg_feedback@ercot.com.

Designated Interconnecting TSP and Large Load Information

the Load Information Form.
